name: review-lab-analysis-only-concern-repository
created_for: offline analysis and future selector design
policy_notes: Do not include this catalog in live code review prompts.
Do not reference this catalog from global skills.
Do not copy this catalog into benchmark child workspaces.
Use only for offline mining, categorization, and selector experiments with separate measurement.

concerns.generic_invariant: A remote fetch must restrict schemes before network access.
questions: Can attacker-controlled input select file, gopher, ftp, or other non-http schemes?
Is validation applied before redirects or only to the first URL?
common_false_positives: URL is hardcoded
URL comes from trusted config with deployment controls

concerns.generic_invariant: Host allowlists must compare canonical hostnames exactly or by validated suffix boundary.
questions: Does substring matching allow sibling or suffix spoofing?
Are ports, trailing dots, case, and punycode normalized consistently?
common_false_positives: URL parser already returns canonical host and exact comparison is used

concerns.generic_invariant: Server-side fetches must block private, loopback, link-local, and metadata network targets after DNS resolution.
questions: Can DNS resolve a public-looking host to internal addresses?
Are redirects rechecked against private network rules?
common_false_positives: fetch runs only in a client browser
network egress is isolated by infrastructure policy

concerns.generic_invariant: Redirect targets must preserve the same trust policy as the original URL.
questions: Does the client follow redirects automatically?
Are scheme, host, and private-network checks repeated for each redirect hop?
common_false_positives: redirects are disabled
redirects are handled by a safe proxy

concerns.generic_invariant: Remote content fetches need explicit timeout, maximum bytes, and content-type or decoder checks.
questions: Can a slow or huge response tie up workers?
Can content type or extension select an unsafe decoder path?
common_false_positives: upstream gateway enforces hard body and duration limits

concerns.generic_invariant: Cross-frame messages must use a precise target origin and validate sender origin exactly.
questions: Is targetOrigin a full URL, wildcard, or stale referrer?
Does receiver parse event.origin rather than trusting event.data?
common_false_positives: same-origin frame with no attacker-controlled ancestor

concerns.generic_invariant: Origin checks must not accept attacker-controlled sibling domains or path substrings.
questions: Does the code compare origin strings without URL parsing?
Are scheme and port included in the trusted origin?
common_false_positives: allowlist values include leading dot semantics and boundary checks

concerns.generic_invariant: Frame permission must not rely on spoofable or privacy-stripped referrer data.
questions: Does the frame decision fall back open when referrer is absent?
Does policy distinguish trusted embed hosts from arbitrary parents?
common_false_positives: route is public and intentionally embeddable

concerns.generic_invariant: Values rendered into JavaScript must use JavaScript-string escaping, not HTML escaping alone.
questions: Can URL, title, or referrer break out of a quoted JS context?
Does template helper escape for the actual sink type?
common_false_positives: value is JSON-encoded by a trusted serializer

concerns.generic_invariant: New windows that navigate cross-origin should not retain opener privileges unless intentionally needed.
questions: Is rel=noopener applied?
Can popup callbacks be confused across origins or tabs?
common_false_positives: browser framework always adds noopener

concerns.generic_invariant: Bulk/list authorization must be equivalent to per-item authorization.
questions: Does the list predicate include every parent or inherited permission checked per item?
Can count/search reveal inaccessible objects?
common_false_positives: bulk endpoint returns only objects already scoped by tenant partition

concerns.generic_invariant: Boolean combinations of roles must match the intended permission lattice.
questions: Did an AND replace intended OR or vice versa?
Are owner-only, admin-only, and admin-owner cases tested separately?
common_false_positives: business rule intentionally requires both roles and docs say so

concerns.generic_invariant: Inherited permissions must be applied consistently across all lookup paths.
questions: Does direct membership logic diverge from inherited membership logic?
Do search/count paths walk the same hierarchy?
common_false_positives: feature explicitly excludes inherited membership

concerns.generic_invariant: Authentication callbacks must bind state to the right session/user and handle absent or mismatched state safely.
questions: Can callback proceed with missing state?
Is state signed, scoped, and consumed once?
common_false_positives: identity provider library enforces state before application callback

concerns.generic_invariant: Token IDs and parsed auth fields must round-trip without ambiguity across all grant variants.
questions: Can separators appear inside user-controlled components?
Does shortcut encoding collide across grant types?
common_false_positives: parser consumes a fixed internal format never exposed to user input

concerns.generic_invariant: Raw SQL writes must preserve model-level normalization, callbacks, defaults, and constraints.
questions: Does the model normalize fields that the migration writes directly?
Will old rows bypass canonical storage format?
common_false_positives: database generated column or constraint performs the same normalization

concerns.generic_invariant: Schema migrations must preserve read/write compatibility for old, new, and rolled-back code.
questions: Can existing rows violate new assumptions?
Does rollback code read new data safely?
common_false_positives: online migration framework guarantees phased deploy order

concerns.generic_invariant: The key used to write, read, update, and delete a resource must be identical after normalization.
questions: Does one side include tenant/user/time suffix that the other omits?
Are display IDs confused with storage IDs?
common_false_positives: key translation table is explicitly shared and tested

concerns.generic_invariant: Cache invalidation must target the same scope and canonical key as cache population.
questions: Can one tenant invalidate another or fail to invalidate itself?
Do configuration changes invalidate derived values?
common_false_positives: cache is request-local and discarded before mutation can matter

concerns.generic_invariant: Persistent or cross-process keys must use stable serialization and hashing.
questions: Does built-in hash randomization affect persisted keys?
Is hash used only inside one process lifetime?
common_false_positives: hash is used only for ephemeral in-memory bucketing

concerns.generic_invariant: Missing, false, zero, empty, and null must be distinguished when domain semantics differ.
questions: Does false get treated as missing?
Does blank input trigger mutation before validation?
common_false_positives: domain explicitly treats all falsy values as absence

concerns.generic_invariant: Canonicalization must be applied consistently at write, lookup, compare, and unique-index boundaries.
questions: Does one path lower-case while another preserves case?
Does locale-sensitive casing produce different keys?
common_false_positives: database collation enforces intended comparison semantics

concerns.generic_invariant: Key types must be normalized when data crosses serialization boundaries.
questions: Can String and Symbol versions of the same key create double loads or misses?
Does serialization convert keys before cache lookup?
common_false_positives: framework normalizes keys at object construction

concerns.generic_invariant: Host, port, and origin representations must be normalized for the exact security or routing decision.
questions: Does storage strip port while runtime compare includes it?
Are default ports and trailing dots normalized?
common_false_positives: the domain model intentionally treats host and origin as different concepts

concerns.generic_invariant: Single-use resources must be checked and consumed atomically.
questions: Can concurrent requests both pass the check before either writes?
Does database update include the consumed predicate?
common_false_positives: outer transaction uses serializable isolation or row lock

concerns.generic_invariant: Shared lazy state must be thread-safe and canonicalized across equivalent keys.
questions: Can two threads partially initialize the same state?
Can equivalent keys create duplicate entries?
common_false_positives: runtime is single-threaded for the relevant object

concerns.generic_invariant: Queue shutdown must preserve intended drain, cancellation, and worker wakeup semantics.
questions: Does the runtime API support the requested shutdown mode?
Can producers enqueue after shutdown or consumers hang?
common_false_positives: queue abstraction wraps the runtime API with compatible behavior

concerns.generic_invariant: Concurrent cache misses should not duplicate unsafe side effects or persist stale failures.
questions: Does the second check happen inside the lock?
Are failed loads cached permanently?
common_false_positives: duplicated load is idempotent and cheap by design

concerns.generic_invariant: Multi-resource cleanup must define ordering, retry, and partial failure behavior.
questions: Can local deletion hide a still-live remote resource?
Is retry idempotent after partial success?
common_false_positives: remote resource has independent expiration and low impact

concerns.generic_invariant: Equivalent error branches should preserve documented response shapes.
questions: Does a new branch return a string where clients expect an object?
Do status code and body semantics agree?
common_false_positives: endpoint is private and no stable response contract exists

concerns.generic_invariant: Pagination inputs must be bounded before they reach slicing or database offset semantics.
questions: Can negative offset produce empty/wrong slices or expensive queries?
Are cursor and limit validated together?
common_false_positives: framework validates query params before handler execution

concerns.generic_invariant: Status code, error type, and documented client behavior must remain aligned after refactor.
questions: Did a generic exception replace a typed HTTP error?
Do clients branch on old status codes?
common_false_positives: error path is intentionally normalized across endpoints

concerns.generic_invariant: Count/search/list queries must apply equivalent filters unless differences are intentional.
questions: Can UI show count for inaccessible or absent records?
Does pagination use a different predicate than the returned rows?
common_false_positives: count intentionally reports unfiltered global total

concerns.generic_invariant: Retried external operations need stable idempotency or safe duplicate handling.
questions: Can retry create duplicate remote objects?
Is idempotency key stable across process restarts?
common_false_positives: external provider guarantees idempotency for the operation

concerns.generic_invariant: Rendered list identity must be stable and unique across reorder, insert, and delete operations.
questions: Does missing or index key corrupt local component state?
Can duplicate keys collapse rows?
common_false_positives: static list never reorders and children are stateless

concerns.generic_invariant: UI callbacks must read current state or declare the dependencies they use.
questions: Can async handler commit stale values?
Does dependency omission hide a changing prop or permission?
common_false_positives: value is intentionally stable by ref or external invariant

concerns.generic_invariant: Optimistic UI changes must rollback or reconcile on failure and race with later mutations safely.
questions: Can failed mutation leave UI in impossible state?
Does rollback overwrite a newer successful update?
common_false_positives: server push immediately reconciles every client state

concerns.generic_invariant: Form state must reset or persist intentionally across open/close, entity switch, and validation failure.
questions: Can errors from one entity appear on another?
Does invalid input mutate state before validation?
common_false_positives: form component is remounted with a stable unique key

concerns.generic_invariant: Disabled UI affordances must not be the only enforcement of a server-side rule.
questions: Can API call still be made directly?
Can double click or stale disabled state submit twice?
common_false_positives: control only improves UX and server guard is unchanged

concerns.generic_invariant: Mechanical style substitutions need outlier checks against context and theme semantics.
questions: Does one replacement invert contrast relative to siblings?
Are dark and light mode variants both updated?
common_false_positives: design system token guarantees accessible contrast

concerns.generic_invariant: Layout migrations must preserve non-JS, legacy, and alternate DOM variants.
questions: Did removed float/inline behavior align a no-JS branch?
Do flex children need min-width or shrink constraints?
common_false_positives: alternate DOM path was removed in the same change

concerns.generic_invariant: Vendor-prefixed declarations must map to valid equivalent properties for supported browsers.
questions: Is an invalid prefixed property harmless because a valid one is also emitted?
Does order affect fallback behavior?
common_false_positives: project no longer supports the prefixed browser

concerns.generic_invariant: State-specific colors must preserve contrast and semantic distinction across all themes.
questions: Can hover and selected become indistinguishable?
Does disabled text fall below readability threshold?
common_false_positives: component is decorative and non-interactive

concerns.generic_invariant: Changed templates must remain syntactically renderable in every branch.
questions: Did a conditional or closing tag use invalid template syntax?
Is the branch covered by template rendering tests?
common_false_positives: template preprocessor rewrites the syntax before render

concerns.generic_invariant: Locale fallback and pluralization must preserve key shape, count semantics, and missing-key behavior.
questions: Can fallback hide missing plural variants?
Do locale files load for every execution context, not just controllers?
common_false_positives: framework handles fallback and pluralization centrally

concerns.generic_invariant: Locale caches must be thread-safe and invalidate when locale configuration changes.
questions: Can one thread see partial loaded locale state?
Does changing default locale leave stale fallback data?
common_false_positives: locale configuration is immutable after boot

concerns.generic_invariant: Wrappers and helpers must honor runtime options in every dispatch branch.
questions: Does an option select a tool/API with different argument semantics?
Are fallback branches updated along with the main branch?
common_false_positives: option is dead or fixed by configuration

concerns.generic_invariant: Overrides and wrappers must preserve expected signatures, return values, and side effects.
questions: Does caller dispatch to override at runtime?
Did wrapper drop parameters or change return type?
common_false_positives: override is never registered or selected for the affected type

concerns.generic_invariant: Arguments passed to external tools must match that tool's syntax for the selected branch and platform.
questions: Does one branch pass percentages where WxH is required?
Are shell arguments escaped and ordered correctly?
common_false_positives: wrapper library normalizes arguments before execution

concerns.generic_invariant: Test names and comments should describe the behavior actually asserted when they guide future maintenance.
questions: Does the test cover the behavior it claims?
Would a future maintainer infer the wrong contract?
common_false_positives: mismatch is cosmetic and no product behavior depends on it

concerns.generic_invariant: Tests should assert externally meaningful behavior, not duplicate implementation details.
questions: Would the test fail if the implementation were wrong in the same way?
Are edge cases and failure modes represented?
common_false_positives: unit is intentionally a pure algorithm with known golden outputs

concerns.generic_invariant: Fixtures should include sentinel values that exercise newly changed branches.
questions: Does new logic have a branch only triggered by null/empty/zero?
Do factories hide the missing state?
common_false_positives: branch is impossible due upstream type system or validation

concerns.generic_invariant: Multi-step data mutations must define atomicity and recovery for partial writes.
questions: Can first write commit before later failure?
Are external side effects inside or outside the transaction intentionally?
common_false_positives: operation is explicitly best-effort and idempotent

concerns.generic_invariant: Database result semantics must match the driver/ORM contract used at runtime.
questions: Does the driver return affected rows or last insert ID?
Is zero rows success, no-op, or error?
common_false_positives: wrapper normalizes result semantics before caller sees it

concerns.generic_invariant: User-controlled values must not enter SQL identifiers or expressions without strict allowlisting.
questions: Are parameters bound only for values while identifiers remain interpolated?
Can sort/filter expression select arbitrary SQL?
common_false_positives: input is selected from a closed enum before interpolation

concerns.generic_invariant: Log and metric fields must preserve downstream query contracts or migrate them deliberately.
questions: Did a tag rename split dashboards or alerts?
Do success and error paths emit comparable fields?
common_false_positives: telemetry is intentionally new and no consumers exist

concerns.generic_invariant: Metrics must not add unbounded or sensitive labels unless backend budget and privacy allow it.
questions: Can label cardinality grow per user/request/object?
Does label expose secrets or identifiers?
common_false_positives: label is sampled log field, not metric dimension

concerns.generic_invariant: Secrets must be redacted before logs, errors, analytics, or review comments.
questions: Can exceptions include request headers or raw config?
Do debug logs run in production?
common_false_positives: value is a non-secret public identifier

concerns.generic_invariant: File paths derived from archives or uploads must stay inside the intended root after canonicalization.
questions: Can absolute paths, dot-dot, symlinks, or Windows separators escape?
Are writes checked after resolving symlinks?
common_false_positives: archive library strips unsafe paths and is tested

concerns.generic_invariant: Security headers must be generated consistently across routes, errors, and alternate render paths.
questions: Can error responses omit security headers?
Does dynamic origin reflection include credentials unsafely?
common_false_positives: headers are injected by an upstream proxy for all responses

concerns.generic_invariant: Sanitized HTML and localized content must preserve the same trust contract in every locale.
questions: Can translation introduce tags or attributes not allowed in the source locale?
Is safe-marking applied before or after interpolation?
common_false_positives: translation system escapes all interpolations at render

concerns.generic_invariant: Upload validation should consider magic bytes, declared type, extension, and decoder behavior together.
questions: Can extension choose a decoder inconsistent with content?
Can polyglot files bypass validation?
common_false_positives: trusted upstream scanner rewrites and validates files before app code

concerns.generic_invariant: Processing compressed or encoded content needs limits on expanded size, dimensions, and work factor.
questions: Can small input expand to huge memory/disk usage?
Do image dimensions exceed safe decoder limits?
common_false_positives: processing happens in a sandbox with strict resource quotas

concerns.generic_invariant: Temporary resources must be cleaned up on success, failure, and cancellation.
questions: Can exceptions skip cleanup?
Can cleanup race with async consumers still reading the file?
common_false_positives: temp directory is lifecycle-scoped and swept by an external worker

concerns.generic_invariant: New code solving an existing problem should match established local patterns or explain the deviation.
questions: Is there an existing helper that handles edge cases the new code misses?
Does deviation create a second source of truth?
common_false_positives: new pattern is intentionally introduced and consistently adopted

concerns.generic_invariant: Partial migrations must preserve interoperability until all readers and writers are moved.
questions: Can old and new formats coexist?
Are all call sites, tests, docs, and config references migrated?
common_false_positives: change is atomic within a monorepo deploy boundary

concerns.generic_invariant: Removed or renamed public symbols must have all dynamic and static references updated.
questions: Are dynamic string references searched?
Do tests or docs still invoke removed names?
common_false_positives: symbol was private and only referenced in deleted code

concerns.generic_invariant: Configuration defaults and docs should not diverge from runtime behavior.
questions: Does docs/config/schema/UI default all agree?
Can old environment variables silently override new names?
common_false_positives: docs are generated from runtime schema in CI

concerns.generic_invariant: New API, module, and method references must exist and match the installed dependency versions.
questions: Does the imported symbol exist in this version?
Did code invent a method name that resembles docs from another ecosystem?
common_false_positives: symbol is generated at build time and present in generated sources

concerns.generic_invariant: Abstractions should remove real duplication or encode a real boundary, not obscure simple behavior.
questions: Does abstraction hide important domain constraints?
Are new extension points unused and untested?
common_false_positives: abstraction is required by a framework or near-term migration already in progress
